title: Replacement Vehicle Credit Terms by Kessler GAP Waiver
content:
# Replacement Vehicle Credit Terms by Kessler GAP Waiver

Under the Kessler GAP Waiver Addenda, a holder whose GAP balance benefit has been paid after a total loss may receive a credit toward a replacement vehicle bought from a group store, on the waivers whose schedule below shows a credit above 0.00. The credit is applied to the replacement purchase at the store, not paid in cash.

## Schedule of amounts

| Waiver | Replacement vehicle credit (USD) | Window after the GAP balance benefit is paid (calendar days) | Stores where the credit is honored |
|---|---|---|---|
| Kessler GAP Waiver 125 | 0.00 (none) | 0 | all group stores |
| Kessler GAP Used Vehicle 140 | 0.00 (none) | 0 | all group stores |
| Kessler GAP Waiver 150 | 0.00 (none) | 0 | all group stores |
| Kessler GAP Plus 150 | 1000.00 | 90 | all group stores |
| Kessler GAP Plus 175 | 1500.00 | 90 | all group stores |
| Kessler GAP Commercial 130 | 0.00 (none) | 0 | all group stores |

## Terms of each column

- **Replacement vehicle credit** — the credit toward a replacement vehicle bought from a group store after a paid total-loss claim; 0.00 means the waiver carries no such credit.
- **Window** — the number of calendar days after the GAP balance benefit is paid within which the replacement vehicle must be contracted.
- **Stores where the credit is honored** — every waiver honors the credit at all group stores, that is, at any of the Kessler Automotive Group rooftops.

## Points of reading

- Only the Kessler GAP Plus 150 and the Kessler GAP Plus 175 show a credit above 0.00 and a window of 90 days.
- *Illustration (hypothetical):* a Kessler GAP Plus 175 holder whose GAP balance benefit was paid on Day 0 is inside the 90-day window with a buyer's order signed on Day 90, and outside it with one signed on Day 91.
